verdict: Organic visibility is declining across all three locations this week.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, Google Business Profile was the only channel generating engagement this period — a combined 371 actions (9 calls, 261 directions, 101 web clicks) over 28 days, with zero paid spend running on any brand. That organic signal is now softening: GBP actions fell between 43% and 58% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days at every location, and the final three days of the period recorded zero actions at both AGS and O'Hare — a confirmed drop, not routine weekend noise. Several foundational milestones are overdue, including account reconciliation and the web/SEO root-cause fix, both of which are blocking downstream pipeline data and organic recovery; these are being worked to close before the end of September. Once those blockers clear, outreach sequences and site reindexing can proceed, which is where the next meaningful lead volume will come from.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement has collapsed to zero daily actions at two locations in the final days of the period, and the web/SEO root-cause fix remains unsubmitted — the two issues are likely connected.
watch_item.fix: The SEO root-cause submission and the 342-account reconciliation are both targeted for resolution by September 30, which unlocks site reindexing and pipeline data flow in the period ahead.
